summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, plus test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The 41 tests in test_shacl.py and test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. mypy, black and isort were not run because they are not in the venv and I was told not to install anything. Pre-existing issue, not fixed: a modifier applied to an inverse path produces n3 like ^ex:p*, which SPARQL parses as ^(ex:p*). The cause is in core rdflib/paths.py, which is out of scope.
